note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 (independent judge, working tree) after uncommitted RFC 4739 work changed the cited producers responder.go::handleResponderInbound and responder_eap.go::handleResponderEAP. RFC 3748 Section 4: "Since EAP only defines Codes 1-4, EAP packets with other codes MUST be silently discarded by both authenticators and peers." handleResponderInbound gains a StateAuthReceived arm calling replayCachedResponse then handleResponderAuthRound (multiple_auth.go); that state is set only by answerFirstAuthExchange, reached from handleAuthRequest after a verified AUTH payload (non-EAP first round), and handleResponderAuthRound collects only ID, AUTH, CERT and notifies, so no EAP session exists or is fed there. The StateEAPInProgress arm is unchanged: an EAP round still reaches handleResponderEAP. handleResponderEAP's new settleAnotherAuth refusal sits inside the authPayload != nil (AUTH-from-MSK) branch after verifyRemoteAuth, which never reads the EAP payload; a message with an EAP payload and no AUTH still reaches sess.Process (eap.go), which returns nil for Code 0 or above 4 before any state access, and handleResponderEAP returns at next == nil with no output and the SA kept. fsm.go changes touch handleAuthResponse (RFC 4739 second exchange) only; handleEAPResponse, eap.go::Process and peer.go::Process are byte-identical to the last judgement. The three tagged units are unchanged. TestEngineDiscardedEAPCodesPreserveExchange sends encrypted Codes 0, 5 and 255 into both IKE roles in StateEAPInProgress through handleInbound, asserts state, expected Message ID, last sent message and retransmission state unchanged, then a held-back valid packet at the same Message ID advances each role to matching nonzero MSKs and a verified AUTH. Core units: the authenticator Session.Process answers nothing for Codes 0, 5, 255 and wrong-role Codes, and PeerSession.Process reports a discard with no response, error, Done or MSK (eapdWantDiscarded), state, method and round budget unchanged; legitimate MS-CHAPv2 packets then complete the exchange with matching nonzero MSKs. All three tagged tests pass on the working tree under -race (go test -race -count=1).
